## Work Experience & Key Impact Metrics

### 1. GoPaisa — SDE / Backend & Analytics Engineer
*Fintech & High-Throughput Data Infrastructure (2025 – Present)*
- **Product Category**: Marketing Analytics & BI Dashboard / Fintech Keyset Streaming / Data Ingestion ETL
- **Commercial Analogues**: Fivetran (ETL ingestion), Metabase / Google Data Studio (BI reporting), Datadog / New Relic APM (query latency tuning).
- **66× Query Latency Optimization**: Refactored the Credit Card Payment Panel backend by eliminating N+1 query bottlenecks and restructuring SQL joins, dropping query execution time from 20 seconds to 0.3 seconds.
- **High-Concurrency Streaming Export**: Architected an in-memory streaming export pipeline capable of streaming 1.5M+ financial records in under 15 seconds without memory spikes, protected with global concurrency locking to prevent database starvation.
- **Self-Serve Analytics Dashboard**: Built analytics and campaign performance infrastructure aggregating data across 92 active marketing campaigns and processing 228K+ clicks in real time.

### 2. IncNut Digital — AI Intern (LLM Application Developer)
*Autonomous Multi-Agent AI Systems (Jul 2025 – Oct 2025)*
- **Product Category**: Multi-Agent Customer Support & Retention Automation (LangGraph + Flowise)
- **Commercial Analogues**: Intercom Fin, Zendesk AI Agents, Ada Support, Forethought (in-house enterprise alternative).
- **Multi-Agent Orchestration**: Built production autonomous multi-agent LLM systems with LangGraph and Flowise for flagship D2C wellness brands Vedix and SkinKraft.
- **60% Customer Support Automation**: Automated routine user queries and support ticket resolution using multi-agent intent routing and tool execution.
- **35.7% Churn Reduction**: Refined LLM state transitions and prompt logic, eliminating order cancellation blockers for 35.7% of users.

### 3. TableSprint — Full Stack Engineering Trainee
*Enterprise Low-Code Platform (2024)*
- Built and debugged scalable React and Node.js components for enterprise UI flows.

## Featured Engineering Projects

### 1. AI GitLab Coding Agent (Autonomous SWE Agent & Docker Sandbox)
- **Tech Stack**: TypeScript, Next.js, Docker, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT-4o
- **Product Category**: Autonomous Software Engineering Agent with Hardened Sandbox Isolation
- **Commercial Analogues**: Devin (Cognition), GitHub Copilot Workspace, OpenHands, SWE-Agent (self-hosted alternative).
- **Description**: Production-ready autonomous coding agent connecting to GitLab repositories. Delegates complex software engineering tasks to foundation models, isolates execution inside locked-down Docker containers (non-root, restricted memory, blocked docker.sock), enforces a 3-tier command policy engine (SAFE, CONFIRM, BLOCKED), and automatically opens verified Merge Requests with CI pipeline monitoring.
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/Shubhanshu-ism/gitlab-coding-agent

### 2. PM2 Auto Recovery Alerts (DevOps & Self-Healing Infra)
- **Tech Stack**: Node.js, MongoDB, SSH, Docker, REST API, Webhooks
- **Product Category**: Self-Hosted Infrastructure Health-Monitoring & SSH Auto-Recovery Daemon
- **Commercial Analogues**: PM2 Plus (Keymetrics), Datadog APM, BetterStack, PagerDuty (self-hosted open-source alternative).
- **Description**: A self-hosted infrastructure daemon that continuously monitors remote virtual machines, detects crashed or degraded PM2 Node.js processes, triggers automated SSH self-healing restarts, and dispatches rich alert payloads across Slack, Flock, and Telegram.
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/Shubhanshu-ism/pm2-auto-recovery-alerts

### 3. AI Compare (Real-Time LLM Benchmarking)
- **Tech Stack**: React.js, Google Gemini API, DeepSeek API, Web Streams
- **Product Category**: Dual-Stream LLM Evaluation Suite
- **Commercial Analogues**: Chatbot Arena (LMSYS), Artificial Analysis, OpenRouter Model Comparison.
- **Description**: Real-time dual-stream comparison and benchmarking platform evaluating Google Gemini and DeepSeek models simultaneously on output fidelity, reasoning depth, token consumption, and response latency.
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/Shubhanshu-ism/AI-Compare
- **Live Demo**: https://ai-compare-steel.vercel.app/

### 4. MegaBlog (Full Stack Content Platform)
- **Tech Stack**: React.js, Redux Toolkit, Appwrite BaaS, React Router, TailwindCSS
- **Product Category**: Headless BaaS Publishing Platform (Ghost / Medium / Hashnode alternative).
- **Description**: Modern full-stack content publishing application featuring JWT authentication, rich-text composition with TinyMCE, image uploads, and centralized session/post caching.
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/Shubhanshu-ism/MegaBlog
- **Live Demo**: https://mega-blog-two-indol.vercel.app/
